rows.text: That sounds amazing! It's like I'm listening to my lady singing~
rows.speaker: Soulmatefly

rows.text: Apparently, this instrument was blessed by the Miss Daze... I never expected it to sound so crisp~
rows.speaker: Soulmatefly

rows.text: Dear gray-haired listener: How do you think it sounds?
rows.speaker: Soulmatefly

rows.text: Isn't it! It's like a torrent, bubbling up to bring joy to people and insects!
rows.speaker: Soulmatefly

rows.text: I never knew you played an instrument. You have to let me hear you play one day!
rows.speaker: Soulmatefly

rows.text: I'm sure you must have heard more beautiful music played before. Please, give me some recommendations!
rows.speaker: Soulmatefly
